claims.evidence: The witness describes a 'slim, two-tier rectangular design', which is characteristic of a PS4 Slim, not the original 'big' Fat model.
The witness report states that no controllers were shown.
No games were mentioned or shown in the witness report.
Power and video cables were not shown.
The Liverpool FC skin covers the console's surface, making it impossible to see scratches or wear on the casing.
This requires a close-up photo of the warranty seals, which is not provided.
Functionality and thermal performance cannot be verified through static photos.
The condition of the connection ports was not shown.
No receipt was shown in the report.

risks.risk: The console may be a different model revision than assumed, affecting value.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label showing the CUH-XXXX model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the base PS4 Slim model.

risks.risk: The console may have the minimum storage capacity.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Storage' menu in the console settings.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional (e.g., Blue Light of Death).
risks.proof: A video clip of the console booting to the home screen and launching a game.

risks.risk: The controllers may be missing, third-party, or have 'stick drift'.
risks.proof: Photos of the front and back labels of both controllers, and a video of them in use.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console only, without controllers.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may not accept or read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, loaded, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a faulty disc drive.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back or bottom of the console (CUH-XXXX).
Photos of the 2 controllers and 7 games mentioned.
Video of the console powered on, showing the system storage settings and a game running.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned by the seller.
Close-up photos of the front and rear ports.
response.reason: The witness describes a Slim model while the seller claims it is a 'big' model; the manufacturer's label and proof of the included accessories are required to resolve this contradiction and establish a baseline for valuation.
